title.en: Find your network card's MAC address
title.hinglish: Apne network card ka MAC address dhoondo

why.en: This is the 48-bit address a switch learns from your frames.
why.hinglish: Yeh woh 48-bit address hai jo switch tumhare frames se seekhta hai.

expect.en: A list of adapters with MAC addresses like 3C-22-FB-7A-91-0E (Windows uses dashes). Values differ per machine; on macOS use ifconfig and look for 'ether'.
expect.hinglish: Adapters ki list MAC addresses ke saath, jaise 3C-22-FB-7A-91-0E (Windows dashes use karta hai). Values har machine par alag hoti hain; macOS par ifconfig use karo aur 'ether' dhoondo.

title.en: See the MACs your machine has learned
title.hinglish: Dekho tumhari machine ne kaunse MACs seekhe hain

why.en: Your own table of neighbours, the host-side cousin of a switch's MAC table.
why.hinglish: Padosiyon ki tumhari apni table, switch ki MAC table ka host-side cousin.

expect.en: IP and MAC pairs for devices on your LAN, such as your router. Contents differ per network; on macOS use arp -a.
expect.hinglish: Tumhare LAN ke devices ke IP aur MAC pairs, jaise tumhara router. Contents har network par alag hote hain; macOS par arp -a use karo.

title.en: Check your link speed and state
title.hinglish: Apni link speed aur state check karo

why.en: Shows whether your Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter is up and at what speed it talks to the switch.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki tumhara Ethernet ya Wi-Fi adapter up hai ya nahi aur switch se kis speed par baat karta hai.

commands.windows: Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name, Status, LinkSpeed, MacAddress

expect.en: One row per adapter with status Up or Disconnected and a speed such as 1 Gbps. The Unix command also prints frame counters. Output varies per machine.
expect.hinglish: Har adapter ki ek row, status Up ya Disconnected aur 1 Gbps jaisi speed ke saath. Unix command frame counters bhi print karta hai. Output har machine par alag hota hai.

title.en: Show the Ethernet header fields in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein Ethernet header fields dikhao

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and filter on the broadcast destination or on one MAC.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur broadcast destination ya kisi ek MAC par filter lagao.

expect.en: The ARP broadcast, plus every frame to or from the laptop. Expand the Ethernet II line to see destination, source and type.
expect.hinglish: ARP broadcast, aur laptop ke har frame (aane wale ya jaane wale). Destination, source aur type dekhne ke liye Ethernet II line expand karo.
